Short answer — root cause: PostgreSQL refused the connection because your server’s pg_hba.conf does not have an entry that allows host 10.2.4.19 to connect as svc to database app. That check happens before the password is considered, so the presence of PGPASSWORD in the log doesn’t mean the password was the problem — it’s a host-based auth (pg_hba) rejection. Also: the environment dump in the log leaked a DB password; treat that credential as compromised and rotate it ASAP.

I can draft a one‑liner for the team channel, but confirm first:
- Which channel exactly should it go to (e.g., #infra, #deploys)?
- OK to redact the DB password in the posted text? (recommended)

Reply with channel name and “yes”/“no” about redaction and I’ll produce the one‑liner.
